feature: S3 — Deucalion LLM scale-up (3a → 3b → 3c → 3d, case1-tinytask, nemotron-3.5-lightning:30b)
scope: Run the 4-step scale-up ladder on Deucalion dev-a100-80 with nemotron-3.5-lightning:30b (the proven-fastest strong model per the 2026-09-08 CyberMetric 80Q runs, where it scored 76/80 = 95.0%). Each step MUST gate the next: 3a (single LLM call) → 3b (--run-phase-1b case1, 4 calls) → 3c (--map-only case1, 10 lanes) → 3d (--run-all case1, 9 docs + xlsx). Use the existing examples/deucalion/scout-bench-aegis.sbatch (parameterised via MODEL env var) for 3a/3b/3c; for 3d use scout-bench-aegis.sbatch but without --run-phase-1b. Cluster discipline: battery of local validation commands BEFORE every sbatch, wipe __pycache__, PYTHONDONTWRITEBYTECODE=1, unique port per JOBID, walltime per stage.

criteria.description: Local preflight before the first sbatch: (a) repo HEAD on feature/aegis-p1-corr-116-pipeline-staging matches the S2 commit (8190f0c) + S2's invoker.py changes present; (b) `python -c 'from aegis_phase1.v2.runner import main; print("OK")'` exit 0; (c) `pytest tests/unit/prompts_v2/test_invoker_retry_corr116.py -q` exit 0; (d) `bash -n examples/deucalion/scout-bench-aegis.sbatch` exit 0; (e) `ruff check src/aegis_phase1/prompts_v2/invoker.py` exit 0.
criteria.test_command: cd /home/epmq-cyber/Área\ de\ Trabalho/projects/aegis-phase1 && git rev-parse --abbrev-ref HEAD && git rev-parse --short HEAD && grep -c 'PARSE_ERROR' src/aegis_phase1/prompts_v2/invoker.py && PYTHONPATH=src ../shared-venv-root/bin/python -c "from aegis_phase1.v2.runner import main; print('OK')" && PYTHONPATH=src ../shared-venv-root/bin/python -m pytest tests/unit/prompts_v2/test_invoker_retry_corr116.py -q 2>&1 | tail -2 && bash -n examples/deucalion/scout-bench-aegis.sbatch && echo SBATCH_SYNTAX_OK && ../shared-venv-root/bin/ruff check src/aegis_phase1/prompts_v2/invoker.py 2>&1 | tail -2
criteria.expected: All 5 sub-checks pass; branch + commit + S2 patch + import + test + bash + ruff all green
criteria.verdict: PASS — branch 8190f0c + S2 patch present; import/test/bash/ruff all exit 0
